general_information.name: SORRY — DO YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY ID? I’M A BIT MUDDLED WITH THE WAY THAT’S PHRASED. IT’S JOANNE… AND THEN THE REST, I THINK I’D NEED YOU TO ASK THAT AGAIN MORE PLAINLY.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been a mix of things, really. I’ve been low and cranky and tearful for years now, and the sleep is awful — I wake up at night, with these night sweats, and then I can’t get back properly. Work’s been harder too because I can’t concentrate as well. And I keep thinking I should be coping better, because family life, I mean, I have a husband and grown-up kids and everything should be fine, but I just feel… off.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to sleep through the night, honestly. And stop snapping at my family — that’s the bit that’s really getting to me.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and it was an ordinary, happy childhood. Nothing dramatic, really.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I completed a business degree, and… honestly, there weren’t any significant difficulties back then. It was pretty straightforward.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’ve been married for 24 years, and that’s current. We have two adult children.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to feel steady again and enjoy work.
